_comment: Editorial content for FFLM. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached. A modaraba is a listed Islamic financing vehicle, so products is left empty rather than filled with guessed 'products'.
description: First Fidelity Leasing Modaraba is a perpetual, multi-purpose modaraba — a listed Islamic financing vehicle incorporated under the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980 — managed by Fidelity Capital Management (Private) Limited. It has provided Shariah-compliant credit since December 1991, mainly through leasing and related financing, and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
headOffice: 93, B-1, Canal Park, Gulberg II, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: Modaraba website (fidelitymodaraba.com: home, corporate information, services), read 2026-10-17. The chief executive named is the chief executive of the modaraba's management company, which is how the site presents the role.
